impact: Webhook delivery lagged by up to 41 minutes for 88 integrations.
stated_cause: The webhook queue has no backpressure, so a slow consumer starves every other consumer.
contributing_factors: Consumers share one queue with no per-tenant isolation.
Queue depth is not alerted on.
narrative: Lag was reported by an integrator at 16:20.

action_items.title: Be more careful with consumer changes
